title: Optimizing Postoperative Betablockade with Landiolol on top of oral betablocker to prevent New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation Following Cardiac Surgery in Caucasian patients
official: Optimizing Postoperative Betablockade with Landiolol on top of oral betablocker to prevent New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation Following Cardiac Surgery in Caucasian patients: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind study.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of a preventive infusion of landiolol versus placebo on the incidence of postoperative atrial fibrillation within 7 days following cardiac surgery in Caucasian patients.
conditions: Patient scheduled for elective cardiac surgery using cardiopulmonary bypass, treated with landiolol for the prevention of postoperative atrial fibrillation.

interventions.name: CHLORURE DE SODIUM FRESENIUS 0,9 %, solution pour perfusion
RAPIBLOC 300 mg, poudre pour solution pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient aged 65 years and older
2. Caucasian patient
3. Patient scheduled for elective cardiac surgery under cardiopulmonary bypass with a preoperative left ventricular ejection fraction of ≥ 50%
4. Patient affiliated with a social security scheme or equivalent
5. Free, informed and signed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient under 65 years of age
2. Patient under guardianship, curatorship or other legal protection, deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision, or hospitalized without consent
3. Patient unable to personally provide consent or legally protected adult
4. History of paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation prior to surgery
5. Contraindication to beta-blockers or known hypersensitivity to landiolol
6. Severe conduction or cardiac rhythm disorder (complete atrioventricular block or bradycardia requiring external pacing
7. Post-cardiotomy cardiogenic shock requiring inotropic agents (adrenaline, dobutamine)
8. Vasoplegic syndrome defined by a MAP < 65 mmHg despite vasopressor support with noradrenaline ≥ 0.3 μg.kg⁻¹.min⁻¹ and volume optimization
9. Acute respiratory distress syndrome defined by a PaO2/FiO2 ratio < 200
10. Moribund patient defined by a Simplified Acute Physiology Score II (SAPS II) greater than 90
11. Mental or linguistic inability to understand the study
